name: typecheck
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Tier-1 gate: type checking across the codebase (constitution §2 — TypeScript
# strict). Deterministic; no AI. Self-adapting: a project without a TypeScript
# toolchain yet (the scaffold is still being upgraded from the placeholder) is
# skipped green; a real TypeScript app is type-checked for real.
if [ ! -f tsconfig.json ]; then
  echo "typecheck: no tsconfig.json — not a TypeScript project yet (scaffold pending); skipped."
  exit 0
fi
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/tsc ]; then
  node_modules/.bin/tsc --noEmit
  exit $?
fi
if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1 && npx --no-install tsc --version >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  npx --no-install tsc --noEmit
  exit $?
fi
echo "typecheck: FAIL — tsconfig.json present but no 'tsc' available; install the toolchain."
exit 1

name: constitution-lint
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Tier-1 gate: lint rules enforcing the constitution — PostgreSQL only, Drizzle
# for ALL data access, Zod validation on routes. Deterministic; no AI. Skipped
# green until the TypeScript scaffold exists; enforced for real once it does.
if [ ! -f package.json ] && [ ! -d src ]; then
  echo "constitution-lint: no TypeScript app yet (scaffold pending); skipped."
  exit 0
fi
fail=0
# Forbidden databases / ORMs (only PostgreSQL via Drizzle is permitted).
if [ -d src ]; then
  hits=$(grep -REln "(from|require)[^\n]*(mysql2|better-sqlite3|sqlite3|mongoose|mongodb|typeorm|sequelize|prisma|knex)" src 2>/dev/null)
  if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
    echo "constitution-lint: FAIL — forbidden database/ORM import (PostgreSQL via Drizzle only):"
    echo "$hits"
    fail=1
  fi
fi
# If a constitution ESLint config + binary exist, run them.
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/eslint ] && ls .eslintrc* eslint.config.* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  node_modules/.bin/eslint . || fail=1
fi
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] && echo "constitution-lint: OK"
exit $fail

name: rule-coverage
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Tier-1 structural gate: every confirmed rule must have covering tests
# (constitution §6 / framework §6.3). Deterministic; no AI. Confirmed rules are
# the ANCHORED entries the Define/audit interview appends to state/rules.md as
# "<!-- rule-qN -->" (the older heuristic counted markdown list items, of which
# rules.md has none — so it counted zero and let auth behaviours ship untested).
RULES=state/rules.md
if [ ! -f "$RULES" ]; then
  echo "rule-coverage: no state/rules.md yet; skipped."
  exit 0
fi
# Count confirmed rules by their rule-qN anchor.
rules=$(grep -Ec "<!--[[:space:]]*rule-q[0-9]+" "$RULES" 2>/dev/null); rules=${rules:-0}
if [ "$rules" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "rule-coverage: no confirmed rules yet; nothing to cover."
  exit 0
fi
# Count test blocks across the suite.
tests=0
if [ -d src ] || [ -d tests ]; then
  tests=$(grep -REc "\\b(it|test)\\(" src tests 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '{s+=$2} END{print s+0}')
fi
# Require at least one covering test per confirmed rule (constitution §6).
if [ "$tests" -lt "$rules" ]; then
  echo "rule-coverage: FAIL — $rules confirmed rule(s) but only $tests test block(s); every confirmed rule needs covering test(s)."
  exit 1
fi
echo "rule-coverage: OK — $rules rule(s), $tests test block(s)."
exit 0

name: security-scan
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Tier-1 gate: dependency audit + secret scan (constitution §5 / framework §6.3).
# Deterministic; no AI. The secret scan always runs (a committed key is a
# violation on any stack); the dependency audit runs when a lockfile exists.
fail=0
# Secret scan: private keys and cloud credentials committed to the repo.
if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  hits=$(git grep -lE "BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}" 2>/dev/null)
else
  hits=$(grep -RlE --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=node_modules "BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}" . 2>/dev/null)
fi
if [ -n "$hits" ]; then
  echo "security-scan: FAIL — a private key or cloud credential appears to be committed:"
  echo "$hits"
  fail=1
fi
# Dependency audit (high severity and above) when a lockfile exists.
if [ -f package-lock.json ] && command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  npm audit --audit-level=high || fail=1
fi
[ "$fail" -eq 0 ] && echo "security-scan: OK"
exit $fail

name: test
script:
#!/bin/sh
# Tier-1 gate: run the test suite (Vitest) — one test per confirmed rule plus
# tests for any function with business logic (constitution §6). Deterministic;
# no AI. Skipped green until a test runner exists; run for real once it does.
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  echo "test: no package.json yet (scaffold pending); skipped."
  exit 0
fi
if [ -x node_modules/.bin/vitest ]; then
  node_modules/.bin/vitest run
  exit $?
fi
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && grep -q "\"test\"" package.json 2>/dev/null; then
  npm test --silent
  exit $?
fi
echo "test: no test runner configured yet; skipped."
exit 0
